callingAssumptions: Readable live 32-byte initial input ranges and a writable live 32-byte output range
Input and output ranges may overlap arbitrarily
Each base plus 31 fits in the 64-bit native address space
No concurrent mutation or data race during the call
UInt256 type initialization has completed successfully before the call
Sufficient runtime stack and no asynchronous runtime failure
trustAssumptions: Lean kernel and accepted foundational axioms
Mono.Cecil and extractor faithfully translate the freshly built artifact
The formal CIL and runtime models faithfully describe the selected environment
Assembly digest identifies an artifact without proving extraction correctness
CoreCLR, JIT and hardware fidelity are not proved
managedDependencies: Discovered reachable acyclic managed calls from the exact public entry signature
termination: Existence of a proved finite sufficient fuel bound; no numerical budget in the public contract
